_: What this repository's gate reads beyond the code-shaped default (sources, tests, proofs, build and project files, the gate scripts). A commit touching only files outside the union is gate-inert, and a green run may stand across it. The gate is run.ps1: the suites in the test-suites.json roster, the Fable stage, the validator-coverage check, the defect-code check, the browser-script harness and the renderer writer's self-test, and the generated-artefact drift checks (Build.fsproj -- DriftChecks, which reconciles the authoring pack under docs/). No stage sweeps the tracked set. The entries are those stages' inputs and the documents the suites open; the wire-format corpus most suites read lives outside this repository. Checked, not trusted: src/Fuaran.UI.Tests/GateReadsCensusTests.fs. Phase 1012: `builds` names what the gate builds — Fuaran.sln, Build.fsproj (its DriftChecks target), and the projects the Fable stage (tests/fable-laws/fable-check.ps1) compiles — and `notBuilt` each project file the gate deliberately does not, with the reason; the coverage check holds the pair to the tracked project files, and an unreached project is an error once `builds` is declared.
